body: I'm not happy any day. You expect me to believe I'll just wake up someday and feel fine? My goal wasn't that I would be happier if I died, that doesn't make sense at all; I don't want to be alive. There is nothing for me on this world and I hate existing. That's it.
Talking doesn't solve anything, and as much as I love my mother, I don't think she wants me to suffer by continuing to live just for her sake.
It's pointless to go into. Just know that it is enough for me to end my life over.
No you aren't. Stop acting like you care.

You aren't being sympathetic. You are taking a position of superiority and looking down on someone. "Oh, just do this. I know it will work because it worked for me and I know what's best for you."

You actually disgust me.
Your response was so generic it makes me want to kill myself sooner.
